title: TX_SF announcement absent: no 1-byte current-TX_SF field in DIO options or Announce messages
description:
Req R-02-016 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.5, MUST): 'Gateways and nodes MUST announce current TX_SF in DIO options and Announce messages (1-byte field; absence means SF10).'

Classification: not-implemented.
Evidence: only the ASSIGNED_SF TLV [0x14,1,sf] exists (rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs:140-153), which is gateway assignment, not per-node current-TX_SF announcement. Announce wire carries rx_channel (0-7) but no TX_SF byte (rust/lichen-core/src/announce.rs:75-127,111-114). Grep for tx_sf across rust/, lichen/, python/src: no announce/DIO usage. C announce builders: no SF field.

Suggested placement: extend Announce app_data or a DIO option with 1-byte TX_SF (absence=SF10) in rust/lichen-core/src/announce.rs + C announce builder + python announce model; update wire-format vectors.
